chapter: Later years and the club's fate
title: The El Moraco and a visiting English group
summary: George Lewis once played the El Moraco; later a group from England played there.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: What about the El Moraco? That was the place where they used to have some, um, George used to play there.
George played at the El Moraco many, many, many years ago.
I don't know for how long. He was at the El Moraco.

And what other bands they had, I don't know, but, uh, I see they were, they wind up with girl shows and, uh, with this crusading discraternity that looked down his nose on girl shows and girl activities. They were closed up. And, uh, so they didn't have a real girl shows or Dixieland either. But they did a year ago, I'm sorry, a year ago. They had a little group from England, I believe. Right. You were acquainted with them? No, I wasn't playing. I went down there and I didn't know.
Yeah. And they stayed there a while and then they drifted away where to, I don't know.
I think some of them went back to England.
I can see just from seeing that, it's difficult for them, for anybody to make it to that kind of music, because I know they didn't really have any big business down there.
